## Remediation Plan v3 (after 2 opus-review cycles)

**Verdict**: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS (10 from v2 review folded in).

### Bug B v3 fix scope — Shared `cycle_marker_format` module (B3)

New module at `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/cycle_marker_format.py` with:
- `format_marker(*, cycle_num, pr_number, commit_sha, findings_hash, tuples, continuation=None) -> str` — v1.2.0-compliant emit
- `parse_marker(line) -> ParsedMarker | None` — dispatches v1.2.0 → v1.1.0 → v1.0.0
- `dedup_key(cycle_num, commit_sha) -> tuple[str, str]` — substrings guaranteed in any well-formed marker
- `chunk_tuples(tuples, max_per_chunk=50) -> list[list]` — supports Bug D (continuation marker writer wire-up; parser support only in v3)
- `format_arbiter_marker(...) / parse_arbiter_marker(...)` — folds in `DSO-Arbiter-Ruling:` grammar (runner.py:430, 2411 have same broken `cycle=K` form; one module fix covers all three sites)
- Sentinel guards: `pr_number > 0` ValueError, `cycle_num >= 1` ValueError

Co-changes:
- Caller guard: `runner.py:1609` → `if pr_number is None or int(pr_number) <= 0: return`
- Dedup rewire: `runner.py:1652-1657` uses `dedup_key()` (fixes collateral break)
- Writer rewire: `runner.py:1612-1615` uses `format_marker(..., pr_number=N)` (fixes missing v1.2.0 `pr_number=` field)
- Arbiter marker rewire: `runner.py:430` + `runner.py:2411` (folds in companion bug — currently works by accident as substring check)
- Python parsers consolidate: `cycle_ledger.py:55-60` imports from new module
- Shell parser DELETED: `write-cycle-ledger.sh:338-391` removed
- Shell `--reconstruct-from-pr` REWIRED: `exec python3 -m dso_ci_review.cycle_ledger reconstruct-from-pr \"$@\"`
- Shell writer SCHEMA_VERSION bump: lines 308/518/535/537 → `\"1.2.0\"`; add `--pr-number` flag + thread through (otherwise half-migration)

### Tests required

`tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_cycle_marker_format.py` (NEW):
- Round-trip property test (parametrized over cycle_num, pr_number, tuples including edge cases)
- Sentinel guard: `format_marker(pr_number=0)` raises ValueError with contract reference
- Backward-compat: parse v1.0.0, v1.1.0, v1.2.0 forms
- Mixed-format dedup: same `(cycle_num, commit_sha)` across 3 schemas, assert v1.2.0 wins (per cycle-ledger.md:80)
- Continuation parser test (writer wire-up deferred to Bug D)
- Arbiter marker round-trip (or XFAIL with comment if scope-deferred)

Updates:
- `test_runner_cycle_marker.py:38-43`: assert against `format_marker(...)` output
- `test_reconstruction_parity.sh:43-44` + `73-76`: fix the currently-broken positional invocation (test is failing in main today, masking by always exiting early); update to drive the new `exec python3 -m ...` path
- `test_write_cycle_ledger_v110_reconstruction.sh:24`: extend to v1.2.0
- Audit script (NEW): `tests/scripts/audit-historical-cycle-markers.sh` — 5-line one-time historical-marker scan; run during PR #1 prep, attach output to PR description

### Merge order

This bug ships FIRST (dormant on prod — no behavior change because dispatch isn't firing yet). Bug 8a77 ships SECOND (re-enables dispatch). If 8a77 ships before this, the reviewer rotates through 4 cycles per PR with broken markers and never converges.

### Estimated effort

~1.5 days (v2 said 1; +0.5 for shell writer schema bump + parity test fix + arbiter marker fold-in + audit script).

### Related

- Bug 8a77 — provenance-skip; must ship after this
- Bug C (arbiter agent schema_version drift `1.1.0`→`1.2.0`) — bundle into PR #3 (one-line `code-reviewer-arbiter.md:20` edit)
- Bug D (continuation marker writer wire-up) — uses chunk_tuples() shipped here; separate small follow-up PR
- Full v3 plan: `/tmp/sc10-remediation-proposals-v3.md`
- Full v2 plan: `/tmp/sc10-remediation-proposals-v2.md`

### Empirical evidence

CI log for PR #253 (job 77097310363) confirmed:
- `INTEGRATION_SCOPE_COUNT: 0`, `CONCLUSION: skipped` (Bug A surface)
- Even if Bug A were fixed, this bug B would silently keep cycle_num=1 forever
- The cycle-end arbiter has likely never fired on any real PR in this project's history
